section.content: The utility model discloses a biological gene rapid sampler in the technical field of biological gene experiments, which comprises a supporting base, wherein a supporting cylinder is vertically welded at the top of the supporting base, two groups of supporting side plates are transversely welded on the outer wall of the supporting cylinder, the two groups of supporting side plates are arranged in parallel up and down, and limiting screw rods are longitudinally welded at both ends of the outer wall of the supporting side plates, the utility model utilizes the elastic action of a clamping spring to rapidly clamp a plurality of groups of sampling test tubes between a fixed clamping plate and a movable clamping plate, and simultaneously, through the limiting action of an I-shaped slide rail and a positioning slide block, a biological gene stock solution cylinder placed on the supporting side can be accurately dripped into the inner cavity of the sampling test tube, thereby biological gene samples can be dripped into the plurality of groups of sampling test tubes in a short time, the rapid effectiveness of biological gene sampling is improved, and the influence on experimental results caused, the accuracy of experimental data is improved.

本实用新型公开了生物基因实验技术领域的一种生物基因快速取样器，包括支撑底座，支撑底座的顶部竖向焊接有支撑柱体，支撑柱体的外壁横向焊接有两组支撑侧板，且两组支撑侧板上下平行设置，支撑侧板的外壁两端均纵向焊接有限位螺杆，本实用新型利用夹紧弹簧的弹力作用，能够将多组的取样试管快速的夹紧在固定夹板与活动夹板之间，同时通过工形滑轨和定位滑块的限位作用，使放置在上的生物基因原液筒能够准确的滴入到取样试管的内腔中，从而能够在短时间内向多组取样试管的中滴入生物基因样品，提高对生物基因取样的快速有效性，减少因为取样时间间隔较长而造成对实验结果的影响，提高实验数据的准确性。

Biological gene rapid samplerTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological gene experiment technical field specifically is a biological gene rapid sampling ware.

Background

A gene (genetic element) is the entire nucleotide sequence required to produce a polypeptide chain or functional RNA. Genes support the basic architecture and performance of life. All information of the processes of race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life is stored. The mutual dependence of environment and heredity deduces important physiological processes of life such as reproduction, cell division, protein synthesis and the like. All life phenomena of living body such as growth, aging, disease, aging and death are related to genes. It is also an intrinsic factor in determining life health. Thus, genes have dual attributes: materiality (presence) and informativeness (root attributes). DNA fragments carrying genetic information are called genes, and other DNA sequences, some of which act directly on their own structure and some of which are involved in regulating the expression of the genetic information. The simple life is composed of 265 to 350 genes at minimum.

At biological gene experiment's in-process, need carry out sample analysis to biological gene, it is comparatively accurate for experimental analysis's result, can carry out multiunit sample analysis usually, the present sampling process majority that is used for the gene is single to take a sample, comparatively loaded down with trivial details and efficiency are slower, can influence the accuracy of experimental result because the interval time of sample is longer and cause the great phenomenon of the difference nature of experimental result, based on this, the utility model designs a biological gene quick sampler to solve above-mentioned problem.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biological gene rapid sampling ware, in order to solve the in-process at biological gene experiment that proposes in the above-mentioned background art, need carry out sample analysis to biological gene, it is comparatively accurate for experimental analysis's result, can carry out the sample analysis of multiunit usually, the present sampling process majority that is used for the gene is single to take a sample, comparatively loaded down with trivial details and efficiency are slower, can probably cause the great phenomenon of the difference nature of experimental result because the interval time of sample is longer, influence the problem of the accuracy of experimental result.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a biological gene rapid sampler comprises a supporting base, wherein a supporting cylinder body is vertically welded at the top of the supporting base, two groups of supporting side plates are transversely welded on the outer wall of the supporting cylinder body, the two groups of supporting side plates are arranged in parallel up and down, limiting screw rods are longitudinally welded at both ends of the outer wall of each supporting side plate, a fixed clamping plate and a movable clamping plate are transversely installed between the two groups of limiting screw rods, the fixed clamping plate is arranged at the front part of the movable clamping plate, limiting clamping grooves are vertically and uniformly formed in the rear side wall of the fixed clamping plate and the front side wall of the movable clamping plate, a sampling test tube is vertically installed between the two groups of limiting clamping grooves, the bottom of the sampling test tube is arranged below the lower fixed clamping plate and the lower movable clamping plate, clamping springs are longitudinally installed between the movable clamping plate and the supporting side plates and are sleeved on the outer wall of the, and the worker's shape slide rail is on a parallel with the top setting that supports the base, the outer wall joint of worker's shape slide rail has the location slider, the outer wall horizontal welding of location slider has the locating support.

Preferably, reinforcing rib plates are symmetrically welded between the top of the supporting base and the side wall of the supporting column body, between the side wall of the supporting column body and the rear wall of the supporting side plate, and between the side wall of the supporting column body and the rear side of the I-shaped sliding rail.

Preferably, the fixed splint and the movable splint have the same structure, and are fixedly arranged between the fixed splint and the limit screw, and the movable splint can slide back and forth on the outer wall of the limit screw.

Preferably, the internal diameter of spacing draw-in groove is the same with the external diameter of sample test tube, and the inner chamber lateral wall of spacing draw-in groove bonds and has rubber protection pad.

Preferably, the lateral wall of location slider has seted up with worker shape slide rail matched with T type draw-in groove, and the location slider can slide about the outer wall of worker shape slide rail, the axle center of locating support and the axle center of sample test tube are on same vertical line.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the utility model discloses utilize clamping spring's elastic force effect, can be with the quick clamp of the sample test tube of multiunit between solid fixed splint and movable splint, simultaneously through the limiting displacement of worker shape slide rail and location slider, make the biological gene stoste section of thick bamboo placed on can be accurate instil into the inner chamber of sample test tube, thereby can instil into biological gene sample to multiunit sample test tube in the short time, improve the quick validity to biological gene sample, reduce because the sampling time interval is longer and cause the influence to the experimental result, improve the accuracy of experimental data.

Of course, it is not necessary for any particular product to achieve all of the above-described advantages at the same time.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings used in the description of the embodiments will be briefly introduced below, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious for those skilled in the art that other drawings can be obtained according to these drawings without creative efforts.

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is an enlarged view of part A of the present invention;

figure 3 is a rear view axonometric view of the utility model.

In the drawings, the components represented by the respective reference numerals are listed below:

1-supporting base, 2-supporting column, 3-supporting side plate, 4-limiting screw rod, 5-fixed clamping plate, 6-movable clamping plate, 7-limiting clamping groove, 8-sampling test tube, 9-clamping spring, 10-I-shaped sliding rail, 11-positioning slide block, 12-positioning support and 13-reinforcing rib plate.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments of the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person of ordinary skill in the art without creative efforts belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-3, the present invention provides a technical solution: a biological gene rapid sampler comprises a supporting base 1, a supporting cylinder 2 is vertically welded on the top of the supporting base 1, two groups of supporting side plates 3 are transversely welded on the outer wall of the supporting cylinder 2, the two groups of supporting side plates 3 are arranged in parallel up and down, limit screws 4 are longitudinally welded on both ends of the outer wall of each supporting side plate 3, a fixed clamping plate 5 and a movable clamping plate 6 are transversely installed between the two groups of limit screws 4, the fixed clamping plate 5 is arranged at the front part of the movable clamping plate 6, limit clamping grooves 7 are vertically and uniformly arranged on the rear side wall of the fixed clamping plate 5 and the front side wall of the movable clamping plate 6, a sampling test tube 8 is vertically installed between the two groups of limit clamping grooves 7, the bottom of the sampling test tube 8 is arranged below the lower fixed clamping plate 5 and the movable clamping plate 6, a clamping spring 9 is longitudinally installed between the movable clamping plate 6 and the supporting side, the welding of the top of support cylinder 2 has worker's shape slide rail 10, and worker's shape slide rail 10 is on a parallel with the top setting that supports base 1, and the outer wall joint of worker's shape slide rail 10 has location slider 11, and the outer wall horizontal welding of location slider 11 has locating support 12.

Wherein, reinforcing rib plates 13 are symmetrically welded between the top of the supporting base 1 and the side wall of the supporting column 2, between the side wall of the supporting column 2 and the rear wall of the supporting side plate 3, and between the side wall of the supporting column 2 and the rear side of the I-shaped slide rail 10, so that the structural strength of the product is improved, the fixed clamping plate 5 and the movable clamping plate 6 are same in structure, the fixed clamping plate 5 and the limit screw 4 are fixedly arranged, the movable clamping plate 6 can slide back and forth on the outer wall of the limit screw 4, a sampling test tube 8 is conveniently clamped and fixed between the fixed clamping plate 5 and the movable clamping plate 6, and is detached from the fixed clamping plate 5 and the movable clamping plate 6, the inner diameter of the limit clamping groove 7 is same as the outer diameter of the sampling test tube 8, a rubber protective pad is bonded on the side wall of the inner cavity of the limit clamping groove 7, and the friction, and reduce the clamp injury phenomenon of solid fixed splint 5 and movable splint 6 to sample test tube 8, the lateral wall of location slider 11 is seted up with worker's shape slide rail 10 matched with T type draw-in groove, and location slider 11 can be at the outer wall horizontal slip of worker's shape slide rail 10, the axle center of locating support 12 and the axle center of sample test tube 8 are on same vertical line, make the biological gene stoste of placing in biological gene stoste section of thick bamboo can be accurate drip into the inner chamber of sample test tube 8.

One specific application of this embodiment is: when the utility model is used, a worker can evenly place a plurality of groups of sampling test tubes 8 between the fixed splint 5 and the movable splint 6 in an inserting way, and simultaneously, under the promotion of the elasticity of the clamping spring 9, the movable splint 6 can clamp and fix the sampling test tubes 8 in the inner cavity of the limiting clamping groove 7 between the movable splint 6 and the fixed splint 5, a biological gene stock solution cylinder is placed in the inner cavity of the positioning bracket 12, the positioning bracket 12 with the biological gene stock solution cylinder can slide from left to right (or slide from right to left) on the outer wall of the H-shaped slide rail 10 under the limiting action of the H-shaped slide rail 10 through the sliding positioning slide block 11, because the axle center of the positioning bracket 12 and the axle center of the sampling test tube 8 are on the same vertical line, the biological gene stock solution placed in the biological gene stock solution cylinder can accurately drop into the inner cavity of the sampling test tube 8 in a short time, biological gene samples can accurately drop into the plurality of groups of sampling test tubes 8 through sliding, the method improves the quick effectiveness of biological gene sampling, reduces the influence on the experimental result caused by longer sampling time interval, and improves the accuracy of experimental data.
